title: Points of the affine w-localization
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $W=A^w$ be the affine w-localization [def-weil-pbc-w-localization]. The points of $\operatorname{Spec}W$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] are pairs $(x,y)$ of prime ideals of $A$ with $y\subseteq x$, and their local rings are $A_y$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. The map to $\operatorname{Spec}A$ sends $(x,y)$ to $y$. The connected components are the fibres of the first-coordinate map to the patch space [def-weil-pbc-w-local] of $\operatorname{Spec}A$, each canonically isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}A_x$. The closed points $(x,x)$ form a Zariski closed subset homeomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}A$ with the patch topology. In particular, $A\to W$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] and $\operatorname{Spec}W$ is w-local [def-weil-pbc-w-local].

proof.text: Apply the fully proved prime-chart theorem [lem-weil-pbc-principal-w-localization-prime-charts] for the bijection e, its contraction formula, continuity to the patch spectrum, and the closed immersions Spec A_x whose images are first-coordinate fibres.

The defining filtered colimit of finite products of principal localizations is ind-Zariski: exhibit its actual colimit presentation and use the proved upstream finite-product, localization and of_colimitPresentation API. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ind-zariski-bijective-on-stalks] to the canonical local-ring map A_y -> W_q. It fixes A, so the inverse of its bijective A-algebra homomorphism gives W_q congruent to A_y as A-algebras.

The preimages of basic patch clopens separate first coordinates and are constant on connected components. Every point of the fibre Spec A_x specializes to its closed point, whose image is the diagonal (x,x); continuity of the spectrum map preserves this specialization. Thus all points of a fibre have the same connected component and distinct fibres lie in different components.

The image of the closed point of Spec A_x under its closed immersion is closed. Since every point specializes to this diagonal point, the closed points are exactly the diagonal. Its complement is the union over f in A of the open sets where f lies in the first prime and not in the contraction. Strict inclusion y < x provides f in x minus y, proving this equality of sets and closedness of the diagonal.

The first-coordinate map restricts to a continuous bijection from the closed points to the patch spectrum of A. Its domain is compact as a closed subset of an affine spectrum. The codomain is Hausdorff: primes differing on f have disjoint patch neighborhoods D(f), V(f). The compact-to-Hausdorff continuous bijection is a homeomorphism, with diagonal inverse. The closed diagonal and unique closed specialization give IsWLocalRing.

Use the proved upstream instance Module.Flat.of_indZariski for flatness of the explicit colimit presentation. The structural spectrum map is surjective because each x is the image of the diagonal point (x,x). Apply Mathlib Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_comap_surjective, the criterion [lem-weil-pbc-flat-surjective-spectrum-faithfully-flat]. Empty spectra cause no exception.

lean.statement: theorem points (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : ∃ e : PrimeSpectrum (algebra A) ≃ {p : PrimeSpectrum A × PrimeSpectrum A // p.2.asIdeal ≤ p.1.asIdeal}, (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (algebra A), PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (algebra A)) q = (e q).val.2) ∧ (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (algebra A), Nonempty (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ≃ₐ[A] Localization.AtPrime (e q).val.2.asIdeal)) ∧ (@Continuous (PrimeSpectrum (algebra A)) (PrimeSpectrum A) inferInstance (constructibleTopology (PrimeSpectrum A)) (fun q ↦ (e q).val.1)) ∧ (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (algebra A), connectedComponent q = {r | (e r).val.1 = (e q).val.1}) ∧ (∀ x : PrimeSpectrum A, ∃ ρ : algebra A →ₐ[A] Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal, IsClosedImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ρ.toRingHom)) ∧ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap ρ.toRingHom) = {q | (e q).val.1 = x}) ∧ (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (algebra A), q ∈ closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum (algebra A)) ↔ (e q).val.1 = (e q).val.2) ∧ IsClosed (closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum (algebra A))) ∧ (∃ h : @Homeomorph (PrimeSpectrum A) (closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum (algebra A))) (constructibleTopology (PrimeSpectrum A)) inferInstance, ∀ x : PrimeSpectrum A, (e (h x).val).val = (x, x)) ∧ Module.FaithfullyFlat A (algebra A) ∧ IsWLocalRing (algebra A)
